manifest.description: Diagnose avoidable super-linear CPU work: nested iteration over the same or related collections, loop-invariant recomputation, and cartesian/product expansion without a narrowing predicate, on a path that matters.
when_to_use: a hot path appears to do O(n^2)+ work over a collection it iterates more than once
pure work is recomputed every loop iteration that could be hoisted
two collections are paired/crossed without a join key or narrowing predicate
a profile or operator hint points at CPU time concentrated in a loop nest
anti_patterns: do not use for small fixed-size collections where n is bounded and tiny
do not use for micro-optimizations a compiler already performs
do not flag nested iteration whose outer or inner bound is provably constant
do not propose behavior-changing rewrites without stating the workload assumption
